# SQLite WASM

Generated from `@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm@3.54.1-build1`, preserving upstream license notices. `tools/vendor-log-sqlite.ts` verifies hashes and precompiles callback modules for Cloudflare.

`bun install` and package assembly generate the ignored assets. Published packages include them. To regenerate locally:

```sh
bun run sqlite:generate
```
